record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The four kernel forms in appliesTo (MINIOR_KERNEL_BLUE / GREEN / ORANGE / RED) declare SHIELDS_UP (all 3 stars, maxPP 50, range 3, passive METEOR in the catalog). The strategy is shared. The plain MINIOR form (not in appliesTo) declares SHIELDS_DOWN; the two abilities toggle the same entity between the forms at runtime, so SHIELDS_DOWN was read only as far as needed to describe that toggle and is not covered by this record.

dispatch.strategy: ShieldsUpStrategy extends AbilityStrategy; requiresTarget overridden to false

record.summary: Form change, no damage: when the cast fires, the unit's index and name become MINIOR, its skill becomes SHIELDS_DOWN and its cooldown is set to 0. No stat, status, shield, heal or damage is applied by this strategy. Because the METEOR passive effect branches on the unit's name, the kernel-specific on-attack effect stops acting after the cast, while the MINIOR form gains +5 speed per hit. The name and skill (but not the entity's other fields) are rewritten at runtime.

targeting.who: none: the strategy ignores its target (declared null)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is false, so MovingState casts it with target null when pp >= maxPP and canCast; the attacking state can also reach the cast with a target, which is ignored.

declaredRaw.ppCost: entity.pp is reduced by maxPP via the base process (not below 0)

effects.scaling: none: no amount is computed, so AP and crit do not matter (crit may be rolled by castAbility but the strategy never reads it)
effects.resolution: the fields are assigned directly; stats such as hp, atk, defenses, speed, range and maxPP are not rewritten by this strategy. The next cast uses AbilityStrategies[pokemon.skill], i.e. SHIELDS_DOWN, whose strategy picks a random kernel form and sets the skill back to SHIELDS_UP.

starBehavior.note: no star-dependent value in this strategy; the units are 3-star in the catalog. (The METEOR passive has a star-dependent multiplier, which is covered by the separate passive record, not here.)

record.positionalConditions: None. The cast needs no target and no position; it fires from the moving or attacking state once pp >= maxPP and canCast.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Two-form toggle. The kernel form casts SHIELDS_UP (becomes MINIOR, skill SHIELDS_DOWN); the MINIOR form casts SHIELDS_DOWN (becomes a random kernel form, skill SHIELDS_UP). The team's cast log records the skill name current at the time of the cast.
record.rawVsResolved: No raw amounts. Declared change: name MINIOR, skill SHIELDS_DOWN, cooldown 0, PP reduced by maxPP. Applied change: the same assignments; nothing is clamped or scaled. The visible consequence on combat (METEOR effect off, MINIOR speed gain on) comes from name checks elsewhere, read in the cited lines.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gates in AttackingState and the requiresTarget === false cast in MovingState were read

Whether other code reads pokemon.name, pokemon.index or pokemon.skill and reacts to the change (only the METEOR effect and the MINIOR speed line were read); the client-side index/animation handling was not read
Why the pokemon.cooldown reset to 0 matters (the consumer of the attack/move cooldown was not traced)
unresolved: ROUTING UNCERTAINTY REFERENCES_OTHER_ABILITIES: the strategy references Ability.SHIELDS_DOWN (assigned as the new skill) and Ability.SHIELDS_UP (broadcast); SHIELDS_DOWN was read only for the toggle description and is a separate record

ROUTING UNCERTAINTY RUNTIME_SKILL_CHANGE: pokemon.skill is rewritten during the fight (SHIELDS_UP -> SHIELDS_DOWN here, back in ShieldsDownStrategy), so which strategy runs on the next cast depends on the runtime state; the catalog's declared skill for the four kernels is SHIELDS_UP only at the start

Whether the forms keep the same maxPP / range after the change: the entity fields are not reassigned by the strategy, so they stay those of the kernel form, but the catalog declares the same 3-star, 50 maxPP, range 3 stats for MINIOR and the kernels
The METEOR passive is covered by the candidate passive-METEOR.json and is only cited here
No other unit sharing the identifier exists in the queue; the plain MINIOR (SHIELDS_DOWN) is not covered
